metadata.case_name: FUNG YUI FUN AND OTHERS v. LIU WING HON AND OTHERS

injuries.description: linear fracture of the right frontal bone of her skull
source: she was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital in an unconscious state and found to have a linear fracture of the right frontal bone of her skull.
In June, 1973, the plaintiff was examined by Dr. Fang who found complete healing of the fracture and that she was in all respects as good as new.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of squama of frontal bone of skull

injuries.description: a slight disruption of the symphysis pubis, the left pelvic bone being displaced upwards and slightly apart from the right pelvic bone
source: An X-ray of the pelvis and right hip was taken and a slight disruption of the symphysis pubis was found, the left pelvic bone being displaced upwards and slightly apart from the right pelvic bone.
I find that this injury was caused by the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic rupture of symphysis pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

manifestations.description: admitted in an unconscious state; regained consciousness two days later
complained of discomfort in the right hip
the disruption of the pelvis will give the plaintiff difficulty in childbirth

if delivery was normal, the plaintiff would take some time to recover and would experience a lot of pain for a month or two, or even more; there would also be more discomfort than usual during the last three or four months of pregnancy
throughout her pregnancy the plaintiff will have more worry and apprehension than normal

losses.description: Disruption of the pelvis giving rise to difficulty in childbirth (left pelvic bone displaced upwards and slightly apart from the right)

losses.category: Loss of ability to give natural childbirth
losses.description: Possibility of deprivation of natural childbirth and the need for Caesarian section; limit on number of children deliverable by section (being three, or at most four)

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Yin-kam (an infant) v. Cheung Wing-chuen and Anr.
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff, a girl of 18, suffered a fractured pelvis and other minor abrasions. She was left with a permanent slight shortening of ¼" of the right leg and a grossly distorted pelvis
